primary_sources.ref: Shoup, Lower Bounds for Discrete Logarithms and Related Problems (1997)
primary_sources.claim: Generic algorithms require square-root-order work; used only as the generic-model baseline, not a lower bound for concrete encodings.
primary_sources.read_depth: Primary search extraction of abstract and generic model; direct PDF open returned garbled text. No claim of proof verification.

primary_sources.claim: Introduction and stated main result distinguish solving, first/last fall, output degree and regularity; degree-compatible solving degree is described as max(last fall, reduced-basis degree). No new proposed certificate is proved by this source.
primary_sources.read_depth: Introduction lines31–53 and Theorem2.9 statement lines290–296; proof not independently checked.

primary_sources.claim: Sections2.2–2.4 describe separable isogenies, their dual composition, torsion kernels, and rational isogeny graphs; used for the transport interface.
primary_sources.read_depth: Pages2–4, lines93–185, including dual-isogeny and rational-kernel statements; no universal class-joining complexity theorem assumed.

primary_sources.ref: Corrigan-Gibbs and Kogan, The Discrete-Logarithm Problem with Preprocessing, ePrint2017/1113
primary_sources.claim: Abstract and introduction state the tight up-to-logarithms generic S*T^2 lower bound with advice; setup and online phases differ.
primary_sources.read_depth: PDF pages0–1 lines0–64; theorem proof not independently checked.

primary_sources.ref: Fouvry, Kowalski, Michel and Sawin, Bilinear forms with trace functions, arXiv:2511.09459v1
primary_sources.claim: Abstract and introduction give stratification and monodromy conditions for bilinear trace-function bounds with multiplicative or monomial arguments. Transfer to x(P+Q) is a new unproved proposal.
primary_sources.read_depth: Abstract and introduction lines64–116. HTML labels v1 while displaying August24,2026; version metadata ambiguity retained, no later-version inference.
